flux_evidence: Spectrum shipped 5 releases in 10 days (v0.2.22→v0.2.26, latest today), the official t2v/i2v template's default duration/frame-count changed, the turbo-vs-stock default flip-flopped again, and dozens of GitHub PRs/issues referencing MiniMax-H3 landed across major inference projects (vllm-omni, sglang, tenstorrent) in the last 24 hours alone.

findings.claim: Open finding from 2026-08-29 (still unrepaired) says the official templates now default to turbo-by-default (LoraLoaderModelOnly at strength 1.0, 8 steps) and that the skill's current 'stock is 20-step res_multistep/simple, Turbo is optional' framing is stale.
findings.reality: Re-diffing all three current template JSONs (t2v, i2v, r2v) shows a ComfySwitchNode gated by a 'Boolean (Enable Lightning LoRA)' primitive whose stored/exposed default is False in every template. On that default path, Steps switch selects the fixed PrimitiveInt 20 (not the turbo branch's 8/4), and Model switch bypasses the LoraLoaderModelOnly node entirely. The turbo LoRA is present but off by default, exactly as the skill currently states. Applying the 08-29 finding's fix_hint now would make the skill wrong.
findings.fix_hint: freshness.json open_findings — close/reverse 'official-template-now-turbo' rather than acting on its fix_hint; SKILL.md and setup-and-workflows.md text is currently correct. Flag this as a flip-flopping value worth a tighter re-check cadence.

new_techniques.what: Community checkpoint 'MiniMax H3_SparseRef15_Hybrid' applies sparse Ref2VA-style reference influence through AdaLN across 15 of the FL2VA transformer's blocks, without LoRA merging, to get reference-image consistency while staying on the FL2VA base (author says use FL2VA-trained LoRAs with it, not Ref2VA ones).
new_techniques.why_it_matters: Offers a third point between plain FL2VA and full Ref2VA hybrid conditioning for holding a reference image's identity without switching checkpoints or task type.

new_techniques.what: ComfyUI-H3-Continuum (xmarre... actually ukr8b3g-cmyk/ComfyUI-H3-Continuum) is a dedicated node pack for chunked long-form H3 video+audio, with per-chunk review/retry ('Takes') and recovery; V3.8 (2026-09-08) is a stability hotfix on an actively maintained project (77 stars, created 2026-08-10).
new_techniques.why_it_matters: A more tooled alternative to hand-wiring MiniMaxH3MotionContext chains or using the single Civitai 'Multishot' workflow already cited, aimed specifically at avoiding chain-seam drift over many segments.

new_techniques.what: Civitai workflow 'MiniMax H3 Ultra Fastest True 4 Steps + HD Sound' V8 (2026-09-07) claims a tuned 4-step pipeline with facial-consistency locking and V2V node integration, ~30% faster than its own V7.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: Another entrant in the already-contested speed-LoRA-strength space; unverified self-reported benchmark, not corroborated elsewhere yet.
